sentences.en: Many European birds hibernate in the north of Africa.
sentences.zh: 许多欧洲鸟类在非洲北部冬眠。

sentences.en: Crocodiles do not hibernate but estivate within caves during the dry season.
sentences.zh: 鳄鱼不冬眠，但在旱季会躲进洞穴中度过炎热的季节。

sentences.en: How many animals can you name that hibernate?
sentences.zh: 你能说出多少种冬眠的动物？

senses.zh: 过冬；（动物）冬眠；（人等）避寒
